name: Hosiden Corporation
summary: Hosiden Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components in Japan, Asia, Europe, Vietnam, China, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Mechanical Components, Acoustic Components, and Composite Components and Others. The Mechanical Components segment offers connectors, jacks, switches, etc. The Acoustic Components segment provides microphones, headphones, headsets, speakers, receivers, etc. The Composite Components and Others segment offers composite equipment.
